nodes.summary: Skill declares a valid name and description and follows the Agent Skills standard.

nodes.label: MCP client conformance
nodes.summary: Pinned official conformance scenarios are compared against a committed baseline for negotiated protocol versions.

nodes.label: McpServerConnection
nodes.summary: The suite exercises the HTTP MCP client used by mcp.json.

nodes.label: signInMcpServer
nodes.summary: The simulated browser exercises OAuth loopback callbacks and repeated scope step-up.

nodes.label: Conformance baseline
nodes.summary: New or missing failures fail the run; newly passing checks require an explicit reviewed baseline update.

nodes.label: Unsupported MCP elicitation
nodes.summary: elicitation-sep1034-client-defaults is a known unsupported scenario.

nodes.label: Dynamic OAuth registration
nodes.summary: The documented baseline uses dynamic client registration instead of Client ID Metadata Documents.

nodes.label: Coding-agent harness suite
nodes.summary: AgentSession and AgentSessionRuntime use the new deterministic harness rather than legacy harness.

nodes.label: Faux provider
nodes.summary: Suite uses packages/ai/src/providers/faux.ts without real provider APIs, credentials, network or paid tokens.

nodes.label: Durable initial release
nodes.summary: Durable harness initial release and per-conversation provider affinity fix.

nodes.label: Provider session UUID
nodes.summary: A distinct persisted UUID per conversation is forwarded for prompt-cache and session affinity.

nodes.label: pi-durable Harness
nodes.summary: A durable extensible agent harness stores Conversations, model turns, tools and application state before publication.

nodes.label: Harness
nodes.summary: One open storage backend and agent machinery serialize atomic commits.

nodes.label: Conversation
nodes.summary: Stateless ID-addressed handle for immutable transcript entries, forks and owned conversations.

nodes.label: Entry
nodes.summary: Immutable record such as pi.user, pi.assistant, pi.tool-result, pi.system, reset or application records.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.summary: Atomic write of entries, documents and tasks; nothing visible before storage succeeds.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.summary: Typed JSON state alongside transcripts, changed only by commits.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.summary: Checkpointed durable state machine owned by Conversation or another task.

nodes.label: Submission
nodes.summary: Awaitable durably admitted input or passive write.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.summary: Process-local extension definitions selected by persisted names.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.summary: Per-Conversation model, thinking level, extension/tool selection, instructions and cwd.

nodes.label: Provider session identity
nodes.summary: Persisted pi.provider UUID survives retries, reset, compaction, model changes and reopen; forks receive a fresh UUID.

nodes.label: Tool replay safety
nodes.summary: Interrupted tools rerun only if replay safe; otherwise produce interrupted results from committed partials.

nodes.label: Request ID deduplication
nodes.summary: Repeated requestId returns the existing Submission.

nodes.label: Conversation viewState
nodes.summary: Hydrated read-only Chord structural state updated after touching commits.

nodes.label: Bounded watch delivery
nodes.summary: At most 100 undelivered frames; overflow replaces suffix with a current whole-view frame.

nodes.label: Inbox steering and follow-up
nodes.summary: Steers join after tool rounds; follow-ups start after answer; passive writes append without a model request.

nodes.label: Compaction
nodes.summary: Headed summary reduces model context while retaining raw history.

nodes.label: Foreground ownership abort
nodes.summary: Aborting a task cascades into owned child work; background tasks form boundaries.

nodes.label: Structured child task waits
nodes.summary: waiting tasks use allSettled or failFast; completing holds outcomes until owned work drains.

nodes.label: Task graph view
nodes.summary: Live Session tasks expose committed ownership, status, background flags and conversations.

nodes.label: Usage ledger
nodes.summary: Per-model and tool usage includes failed and aborted attempts and Session totals are summed.

nodes.label: SQLite storage
nodes.summary: WAL with synchronous NORMAL survives process crashes; recent commits may be lost on host failure.

nodes.label: JSONL storage
nodes.summary: Append-only files and optional fsync implement marker-based publication.

nodes.label: MemoryStorage
nodes.summary: In-memory backend with no persistence.

nodes.label: Extension reload
nodes.summary: Replacing a named extension affects new phases; active tool calls retain their implementation.

nodes.label: Chord delta investigation
nodes.summary: Measured ID-addressed graph prototype was removed; tree/path delta, weak caches and spread-first cloning retained.

nodes.label: Rejected graph tracker
nodes.summary: Reference identity benefits were outweighed by memory, import and hydration costs.

nodes.label: Tree path delta
nodes.summary: Current wire semantics retain tree/path operations; general mutable alias correctness remains unsolved.

nodes.label: Weak proxy cache
nodes.summary: Permanent retention improved but exhaustive reads still allocate gigabytes and became slower.

nodes.label: Spread-first clone
nodes.summary: Shallow spread before recursive replacement preserves compact V8 object layout and reduces clone memory/time.

nodes.label: Measurement ownership
nodes.summary: Benchmarks distinguish retained heap, sampled allocation, maximum RSS and serialized bytes.

nodes.label: Alias correctness
nodes.summary: Value replay does not prove identity/topology preservation across references and reindexing.

nodes.label: Pico5 Chord document guide
nodes.summary: Durable documents are exposed through Chord facets, replicated states and exact committed operations.

nodes.label: Session canvas
nodes.summary: Session-wide canvas document is shared across conversations and explicitly created in a commit.

nodes.label: Diff review family
nodes.summary: Conversation document family key identifies independent review instances; current forks copy into fresh incarnations.

nodes.label: Task output document
nodes.summary: Bounded task-scoped progress retires when task becomes terminal; required final output must be preserved elsewhere.

nodes.label: Revocable transaction draft
nodes.summary: Copy-on-write draft is valid only inside its commit; assigned containers are copied by value.

nodes.label: DocumentState
nodes.summary: Already hydrated read-only state bound to one incarnation; disposal releases observation only.

nodes.label: Chord service facade
nodes.summary: Facets acquire state before setup and expose async JSON methods with trailing Context.

nodes.label: Commit publication pipeline
nodes.summary: Prepare immutable candidate/ops, choose checkpoint, atomically store, adopt and enqueue publication; observers run after line release.

nodes.label: Incarnation retirement
nodes.summary: Retirement delivers null then closes stream; recreation requires new observation and numeric ID.

nodes.label: Watch convergence
nodes.summary: Overflow folds pending frames into one root replacement; watch is not an audit log.

nodes.label: Pico5 implementation handoff
nodes.summary: Normative spec drives ordered vertical milestones; the handoff documents packages 1–23 as implemented.

nodes.label: Storage milestones
nodes.summary: Records, memory, SQLite, JSONL publication and reclamation precede Harness integration.

nodes.label: Tracker transaction milestone
nodes.summary: One tracker per document prepares immutable candidate and operations before atomic storage admission.

nodes.label: Vertical Harness milestones
nodes.summary: Openable Harness, task runtime, no-tool chat, tool round and product state build public paths incrementally.

nodes.label: Structured concurrency milestone
nodes.summary: Task ownership, waiting and completing replace after-dependencies and pi.post-tools.

nodes.label: Compaction milestone
nodes.summary: Task-owned blocking compaction directly appends; manual/background summaries use write submissions.

nodes.label: Extension agents milestone
nodes.summary: pi.agent and live HarnessSettings replace older conversation config and scoped registries.

nodes.label: Lifecycle conformance milestone
nodes.summary: Close seals observation then joins non-cooperative task/tool/hook code before storage release.

nodes.label: Task graph milestone
nodes.summary: Public taskGraph/watchTaskGraph mount live committed task records.

nodes.label: Pico5 normative specification
nodes.summary: Only committed state is observable; one Session atomically stores immutable entries, task records and Chord documents.

nodes.label: Session mutation line
nodes.summary: External effects run outside the serialized commit line; storage/adoption/publication enqueue stay inside.

nodes.label: Positional system replay
nodes.summary: Context replays system section/tool deltas in transcript order.

nodes.label: Entry context reduction
nodes.summary: Newest head and edits determine active model context; tool results follow calls and absent results are synthesized.

nodes.label: Document incarnation
nodes.summary: Logical address may recur but numeric ID is never reused; lifetime is half-open.

nodes.label: Document checkpoint policy
nodes.summary: Definition alone selects complete base versus delta, with exactly-once predicate evaluation.

nodes.label: Access-driven migration
nodes.summary: Read-only token access migrates only in memory; first successful writable access stores a current-version base.

nodes.label: Fork document policies
nodes.summary: asOf copies at entry commit, current copies present state, initial lazily initializes; tasks never fork.

nodes.label: Storage failure poisoning
nodes.summary: Uncertain failures after storage admission publish nothing and require reopening.

nodes.label: Effect sandwich
nodes.summary: Committed intent precedes external effect and committed result; recovery retries safely or records interruption.

nodes.label: Structured ownership tree
nodes.summary: Task/conversation ownership determines abort and idle traversal independently of transcript ancestry.

nodes.label: Waiting and completing
nodes.summary: wait policies synchronize tasks; held outcomes become terminal only after ordinary owned work drains.

nodes.label: Inbox boundaries
nodes.summary: Steers/follow-ups/passive writes are placed according to busy state and tool/final boundaries.

nodes.label: Extension name resolution
nodes.summary: Stored names resolve against current process-local registry; absent implementations remain choices without rewriting state.

nodes.label: Tool recovery policy
nodes.summary: Recovery reruns only when both stored and current tool replay policies are safe.

nodes.label: Dynamic prompt preparation
nodes.summary: Desired sections/tools compare with replayed state and append positional baseline/delta system entries.

nodes.label: Generation task
nodes.summary: pi.generation prepares, requests/polls, retries, classifies and owns its tool round.

nodes.label: Tool task
nodes.summary: pi.tool validates arguments, hooks, commits intent, executes and persists output/results.

nodes.label: Compaction task
nodes.summary: pi.compaction selects a context prefix, summarizes and places a headed summary.

nodes.label: Conversation structural mount
nodes.summary: Active raw transcript and selected built-in documents publish as complete-commit frames; third-party docs mount separately.

nodes.label: Read-only observation
nodes.summary: DocumentState and watches hydrate atomically, retain immutable revisions and bind one incarnation.

nodes.label: Task graph mount
nodes.summary: Live committed task graph excludes derived blocked/ready states, which inspect computes.

nodes.label: CBOR-independent storage contract
nodes.summary: Storage exposes cursor-based scans and detached reads; cursors are backend-opaque JSON.

nodes.label: Memory backend
nodes.summary: Reference storage copies retained writes and reads to model ownership boundaries.

nodes.label: SQLite backend
nodes.summary: One SQL transaction equals one Session commit; indexed Chord bases/deltas remain generic.

nodes.label: JSONL marker publication
nodes.summary: Sidecars append before one main marker; prepared memory state publishes only after marker succeeds.

nodes.label: No CRDT multiwriter
nodes.summary: The initial harness excludes offline multi-writer merge, semantic event journals and auto-checkpoint heuristics.

nodes.label: Pi behavioral evals
nodes.summary: vitest-evals paired documentation variants isolate containers and withhold headline lift when any pair is blocked.

nodes.label: Documentation lift variants
nodes.summary: with_docs preserves coding-agent docs/default prompt; without_docs removes documentation and its routing section.

nodes.label: Paired cohort protocol
nodes.summary: Plans exact case/variant/model/runNumber tasks, alternates repetition order and pairs exact arms.

nodes.label: Container eval isolation
nodes.summary: Fresh container/home/workspace per arm; root-owned hidden graders and dropped UID reduce fixture leakage.

nodes.label: Blocked pair reporting
nodes.summary: Missing, duplicate, skipped, unscored or errored arms block the pair and headline lift.

nodes.label: Host evals
nodes.summary: Non-doc suites run locally with Vitest and are not paired comparisons.

nodes.label: MCP OAuth evolution
nodes.summary: Standalone MCP lifecycle added; later OAuth discovery, scope and metadata handling were hardened.

nodes.label: Client metadata documents
nodes.summary: clientMetadataDocument replaces clientMetadataUrl and returns a document URL and redirect URI per authorization server.

nodes.label: Scope step-up union
nodes.summary: New requested scopes combine insufficient_scope with previously granted scopes.

nodes.label: Authorization server issuer check
nodes.summary: authorizeMcp exchanges code only for matching iss when required by metadata.

nodes.label: MCP SDK MIT license
nodes.summary: Anthropic PBC 2024 MIT license permits use, modification and distribution with notice retention and warranty disclaimer.

nodes.label: MIT notice retention
nodes.summary: Copyright and permission notice must accompany substantial copies.

nodes.label: pi-mcp standalone client
nodes.summary: Transport-neutral Model Context Protocol client independent of official SDK and other Pi packages.

nodes.label: McpClient
nodes.summary: Owns correlation, initialization, timeouts, cancellation, server requests and helpers.

nodes.label: StdioTransport
nodes.summary: Owns stdio framing/I/O with process-group shutdown.

nodes.label: StreamableHttpTransport
nodes.summary: Owns HTTP sessions, GET stream reconnect and dropped-stream resumption via Last-Event-ID.

nodes.label: toLlmContent
nodes.summary: Converts MCP content to model text/images; structured-only results become JSON and other media become placeholders.

nodes.label: AgentTool adapter
nodes.summary: MCP tools can be wrapped as pi-agent-core AgentTool with sanitized bounded names and object schemas.

nodes.label: MCP OAuth subset
nodes.summary: Discovery, PKCE, dynamic registration, token refresh coalescing and insufficient_scope step-up.

nodes.label: McpOAuthStateStore
nodes.summary: Caller-injected store persists credentials; package chooses no browser or credential location.

nodes.label: In-memory transport testing
nodes.summary: createInMemoryTransportPair provides client and adapter test transports.

nodes.label: Pi protocol history
nodes.summary: Introduced CBOR framing and stricter lifecycle schemas; session lists moved to durable metadata.

nodes.label: Durable SessionMetadata
nodes.summary: SessionMetadata replaces runtime SessionSummary for durable listing.

nodes.label: Pi protocol routed envelopes
nodes.summary: Runtime-neutral version 8 envelopes encode opaque strict-JSON payloads with CBOR and length-prefixed byte frames.

nodes.label: Attachment route fence
nodes.summary: {serverId, sessionId, attachmentId} fences calls to logical server, durable Session and live attachment.

nodes.label: Chord opaque payload boundary
nodes.summary: Chord owns service grammar, catalogues, state and Delta codecs; Pi protocol validates strict JSON without business semantics.

nodes.label: CBOR frame codec
nodes.summary: Four-byte big-endian length precedes one definite-length CBOR item; decoders handle fragmented and coalesced streams.

nodes.label: Strict JSON validation
nodes.summary: Rejects non-finite numbers, bytes, undefined, prototypes, cycles and unknown envelope properties.

nodes.label: Protocol resource limits
nodes.summary: Defaults bound payload size to 16 MiB, one million collection entries and 64 nesting levels.

nodes.label: Pi server history
nodes.summary: Server decoupled from agent-core and narrowed SessionMetadata to id; sanitized errors and protocol adapter hardening.

nodes.label: Application-owned SessionMetadata
nodes.summary: Server requires only id; applications extend metadata with storage information.
